description: This file serves as an ASGI entry point for the DataPlaneService, re-exporting the FastAPI application instance from app.main to facilitate easy import for servers like uvicorn. It provides a simple interface for obtaining the FastAPI app object.

methods.name: get_app()
methods.description: Returns the FastAPI application instance configured in app.main, primarily used for testing and server startup.

ctags.name: app
ctags.pattern: /^from app.main import app as app  # re-export FastAPI instance for ASGI servers$/
